tickets.title: Fix neural line classifier lifecycle and parsing pipeline bugs (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. NeuralLineClassifier missing dispose() + _initAttempted never reset
No `dispose()` method. `_initAttempted` permanently latched. After `OnnxLineClassifierService.dispose()`, classifier permanently dead until app restart.

### 2. OnnxLineClassifierService race condition
`_classifyChunk` accesses `_session!` without lock. Concurrent `dispose()` causes null dereference.

### 3. _initFailed/initialized state mismatch
`onnx_line_classifier_service.dart:77-79` — Both `_initFailed=true` AND `_initialized=true` set. Prevents retry.

### 4. Unbounded input in parseStructureAsync
No line limit on `text.split()`. Large pastes cause CPU/memory pressure.

### 5. _lastTierFailures race condition
`recipe_parser_service.dart` — `_lastTierFailures` instance field mutated per-parse. Two concurrent `parseFromUrl` calls share and overwrite, producing wrong user messages.

### 6. CrfTier is dead code
`crf_tier.dart` defined but never added to `_tiers` in `RecipeParserService`. Priority conflicts with LlmTier (both priority=4).

## Why It Matters
Classifier permanently disabled after transient failure. Race condition produces wrong error messages. Dead code adds confusion.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `dispose()` to NeuralLineClassifier that resets `_initAttempted`
2. Add `_disposed` guard in `_classifyChunk`
3. `_initialized` only true on SUCCESS
4. Add `maxLines = 2000` guard
5. Make `_lastTierFailures` a local variable passed through the call chain
6. Either integrate CrfTier or delete it

tickets.title: Fix sharing flow data integrity bugs (6 issues across social services)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. markAsViewed skips counter decrement
`firebase_shared_recipe_repository.dart` — Override calls only `addView`, bypassing `decrementUnreadCounter`. Badge counter permanently wrong. Same in menu/shopping repos.

### 2. importSharedRecipe copies personalTagIds across user boundaries
`social_recipe_service.dart:178` — Copies owner's personal tag UUIDs into recipient's recipe. Dangling refs.

### 3. importSharedMenu partial failure leaves orphan data
Already-created recipes not rolled back on partial failure.

### 4. shareRecipeToGroups passes groupId as friendId
`social_recipe_service.dart:468-476` — Passes group ID as user ID to V1 repo. Malformed sharing records.

### 5. Sort is a no-op
`base_shared_content_repository.dart:674` — `sort((a, b) => 0)` does nothing.

### 6. Base class markAsViewed is dead code
All 3 concrete repos override markAsViewed, bypassing base. Base method writes to non-existent `viewedByUserIds` field.

## Why It Matters
Badge count permanently wrong, imported recipes have dangling tags, group sharing silently fails.

## Suggested Fix
1. Override `markAsViewed` to also call `decrementUnreadCounter`
2. Clear `personalTagIds` when importing
3. Add rollback or continue-on-error
4. Fix group sharing to resolve members
5. Implement date-based sort
6. Remove dead base class method or fix overrides to call super

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions admin endpoint authorization gaps (4 IDOR/access control bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

Multiple Cloud Functions admin/analytics endpoints only check `context.auth` but not admin claims:

### 1. getSiteConfigStats missing admin check
`functions/src/admin/seed-site-configs.ts:325-368`

### 2. getRetagStatus IDOR
`functions/src/admin/bulk-retag.ts:405-483` — Any user can query any user's recipe stats via `userId` param.

### 3. getUnmatchedIngredientStats missing admin check
`functions/src/analytics/track-unmatched-ingredients.ts:162-193`

### 4. getCorrectionStats leaks PII (userIds)
`functions/src/analytics/analyze-corrections.ts:299-357`

## Why It Matters
OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control. Any authenticated user can access admin data and enumerate other users.

## Suggested Fix
Add admin claim check to all 4 functions.

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions security: CORS wildcard, rate limiter fail-open, notification SSRF, path traversal
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. CORS wildcard on LLM functions
`structure-recipe.ts:71`, `ocr-recipe-image.ts:67` — `cors: true` accepts ANY origin. CSRF cost amplification.

### 2. Rate limiter fails open
`rate_limiter.ts:309-313` — Global LLM limit fails open when Firestore unavailable.

### 3. Notification imageUrl not validated
`send-notification.ts:175-176` — Unvalidated URL passed to FCM. Potential SSRF.

### 4. Rate limit records client-writable
`rate_limiter.ts:124-134` — Rate limit state in `users/{userId}/rateLimits/` may be writable by client if Firestore rules allow user subcollection writes.

### 5. Path traversal in cleanup-recipe-storage
`cleanup-recipe-storage.ts:113` — `decodeURIComponent(match[1])` then `startsWith` check. Encoded `../` in URLs can traverse past ownership check.

### 6. Auto-alias approval race condition
`analyze-corrections.ts:261-293` — Read-check-approve not in transaction. Concurrent corrections can cause duplicate alias writes.

## Why It Matters
Cost amplification, rate limit bypass, SSRF, path traversal, data corruption.

## Suggested Fix
1. Restrict CORS to specific origins
2. Global limit fail closed
3. Apply `isAllowedUrl()` to notification imageUrl
4. Deny user writes to `rateLimits/**` in Firestore rules
5. Normalize path after decoding (remove `..` segments)
6. Wrap alias approval in Firestore transaction

tickets.title: Fix PII logging in Cloud Functions (3 locations)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. onSuggestionCreated logs PII
`functions/src/ingredients/on-suggestion-created.ts:50-59` — Logs userId, ingredientName, recipeContext at INFO level.

### 2. LLM functions use console.log with userId and imageUrl
`structure-recipe.ts:142-144`, `ocr-recipe-image.ts:113-115` — `console.log` (not `functions.logger`) leaks user UIDs and full imageUrls into Cloud Logs.

### 3. onFeedbackCreated logs userId
`feedback/on-feedback-created.ts:16-18` — userId at INFO level.

## Why It Matters
GDPR compliance risk. Dietary preferences are special category data. Log retention makes deletion requests harder.

## Suggested Fix
1. Reduce to DEBUG for detailed fields, hash userId
2. Replace `console.log` with `functions.logger.*`, apply `scrubUrlParams()`
3. Omit userId from INFO-level feedback logs

tickets.title: Fix 3 Firestore security rule bugs (engagements, isCollaborative, list query)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Missing collectionGroup('engagements') rule
`getImportedRecipesForUser` uses `collectionGroup('engagements')` but no `/{path=**}/engagements/{userId}` rule exists. Query denied in production. Imported recipes feature silently broken.

### 2. shared_menus collaborator rule uses wrong field name
Firestore rule line 589 checks `isCollaborative` but the SharedMenu model uses `allowCollaboration`. Rule condition is never true — blocks all collaborative menu self-joins.

### 3. list rule uses resource.data (unavailable for list queries)
`shared_recipes` rule line 332 checks `resource.data.sharedByUserId` on list operations. `resource.data` is not available for list queries — always evaluates to null, denying all list queries.

## Why It Matters
Imported recipes broken, collaborative menus broken, list queries broken. Three separate features silently fail due to rule bugs.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `/{path=**}/engagements/{userId}` collection group rule
2. Change `isCollaborative` to `allowCollaboration` in shared_menus rule
3. Use query-based validation or remove the list rule

tickets.title: Fix share dialog and import pipeline functional bugs (5 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. loadFriends stub returns empty list — friends never load in share dialog
`utils/social_content_features.dart:63` — `loadFriends(dynamic service)` always returns `[]`. Called from `UniversalShareDialogViewModel`. Share dialog never displays friends.

### 2. createInvitationLinkInternal returns example.com stub in production
`services/unified/friends/friends_internal_operations.dart:222` — Returns `https://example.com/invite/$invitationId`. Called in production flow (`friends_invitations_operations.dart:253`). Users receive broken invitation links.

### 3. UniversalShareDialogViewModel missing isDisposed guard
Extends `ChangeNotifier` (not `BaseViewModel`), has no disposed guard. `_setSharing`, `_setError`, `_clearError` call `notifyListeners()` unconditionally. Crashes if dialog dismissed during share operation.

### 4. skipLlm option not passed to LLM fallback
`url_import_strategy.dart` — `retryWithoutLlm` passes `{'skipLlm': true}` but `UrlImportStrategy.import` only passes options to `_tryEnhancedParser`, not to `_llmFallback.tryExtraction`. LLM still runs on retry.

### 5. Double HTTP fetch when enhanced parser returns no result
`url_import_strategy.dart` — `_tryEnhancedParser` fetches HTML, then if it fails, `import()` fetches same URL again.

## Why It Matters
Friends never shown in share dialog, invitation links broken, app crashes on dialog dismiss, LLM retry doesn't actually skip LLM.

## Suggested Fix
1. Implement `loadFriends` properly using UnifiedFriendsService
2. Use `DeepLinkService` base URL for invitation links
3. Extend BaseViewModel or add isDisposed guard
4. Pass skipLlm option through to LLM fallback
5. Cache HTML content between enhanced parser and fallback

tickets.title: Clean up lint suppressions, dynamic type abuse, and code quality anti-patterns
tickets.description:
## Finding

### Lint suppressions
- `result_displayer.dart` — file-level `use_build_context_synchronously`
- `user_profile_edit_view.dart` — file-level `deprecated_member_use`
- `unified_recipe_service.dart:360-366` — exception-as-control-flow init check
- 9 files with `unused_import` due to dynamic `_parent` fields
- `tagging_service.dart:476` — production `print()` with ignore:avoid_print

### Dynamic type safety
- `comment_item_widgets.dart` — `dynamic comment` instead of typed model
- `universal_share_dialog.dart:43` — `dynamic content`
- `social_formatters.dart` — `dynamic user` instead of UserProfile
- `shopping_list_generator.dart` — `recipe as dynamic` cast
- `user_display_models.dart` — `dynamic user` factories

## Why It Matters
File-level suppressions hide bugs. Dynamic types bypass compile-time safety.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add mounted guards, remove file-level suppressions
2. Replace dynamic with proper model types
3. Replace late-field exception pattern with boolean flag
4. Fix _parent typing to eliminate unused_import hacks
